{{Vanilla|Ladder}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''ladder''' is a climbable block. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it much cheaper.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Seven sticks make 8 ladders, where vanilla makes 3; the vanilla recipe is removed. A [[stonecutter]] cuts any log into 16 ladders.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ladder.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/ladder_from_stonecutting_any_logs.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

{{Uses|none=}}
